_doc: LEXICAL SUBSTITUTIONS, not respellings. Only for a word that is gone from modern Truku, where a different word now carries the meaning. Requires: (1) no reflex of his word anywhere in the omnibus by gloss, by fuzzy shape and by substring, and (2) his dictionary has no form of the modern word either. The app renders these as MODERN (his original), colour-coded, so the toggle never puts a word in his mouth. Keep this list short and evidenced.
_q'nao: Ail/garlic. Sweep of all 32,212 omnibus words found no qnaw-shaped Allium word; the whole modern field is qusul / pixil / neygi / sangas. He has no qusul-shaped word either, and he separates the native Q'NAO from the loan NEGI = oignon.
